checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and pull last IDT review note and care-plan goals for comparison, since enrollment was 2025-07-12.
Falls and injuries: count falls, near-falls, and fractures in the window; given osteoporosis and opioid use, check for any fall-related injury, fracture, or new mobility aid.

Medication changes: review new starts and stops since last review. Specifically check the hydrocodone/acetaminophen start (2026-02-05) for current use, dose changes, refill frequency, sedation, constipation, and any early refill requests; confirm bowel regimen status if documented.

Medication changes: confirm simvastatin 10 mg (started 2025-12-22) adherence, most recent lipid panel, and any muscle symptoms reported; note the record lists no allergies, so verify allergy status with patient.
Weight and BMI trend: obesity (BMI 30+) is on the problem list; check weights over the window, direction of change, and whether any nutrition or weight-management referral is active.

Pain: review chronic pain and chronic low back pain scores, functional limits from pain, non-opioid pain strategies tried, and whether pain goals in the care plan are being tracked.

Prostate history (prostate neoplasm and carcinoma in situ, onset 2011): check for any urology or oncology follow-up, PSA monitoring, urinary symptoms, or treatment-related changes; note no prostate-specific medications are on the active list.
Function and ADLs/IADLs: compare current ADL and IADL status with prior review, including transfers, bathing, stairs, driving, and medication management.

Cognition, mood, and social: screen for depression or low mood, sleep changes, and cognitive concerns; document any changes in caregiver support, living situation, or transportation in Los Angeles, and check attendance at PACE center visits and therapies.
Care-plan items due: list any assessments, reassessments, or goals with due dates falling in the window and flag overdue items for IDT discussion.
